strings.Optics and precision instruments: princi: Ilimin haske da kayan aunawa na daidaito: ƙa'idodi, lissafi, tabbatarwa.
strings.Each course works through mechanism, qua: Kowane kwas yana bin hanyar aiki, misalin lissafi, tabbatarwa da gano musabbabin lalacewa: daga litografi na EUV, interferometri da maikroskopi na elektron zuwa tushen hasken sinkrotron, na'urorin gano raƙuman nauyi da manyan na'urorin hangen nesa. Sashe na farko na kowane kwas kyauta ne.

strings.Start with optical design, fabrication a: Fara da zanen na'urorin haske, ƙerawa da shafe-shafe, sannan ka matsa zuwa maikroskopi, spektroskopi da aunawa na daidaito.

strings.Cloud accounts are not configured on thi: Ba a saita asusun gajimare a wannan shafin yanar gizo ba. Bayanan martaba na koyo na gida da fitar da ci gaba suna nan. Dole mai shafin ya saita aikin Supabase, ma'ajiyar bayanai da URL na dawowar tantancewa kafin rajistar memba (sunan mai amfani, kalmar sirri, imel da lambar wayar hannu) da daidaitawa tsakanin na'urori su yi aiki.
strings.See docs/PAYMENTS_V12_ZH.md and supabase: Duba docs/PAYMENTS_V12_ZH.md da supabase/002_accounts_commerce.sql a cikin kunshin. Kada ka taɓa saka maɓallin sabis na sirri a cikin shafin yanar gizo.
strings.Your username, email, mobile number and: Ana adana sunan mai amfaninka, imel, lambar wayar hannu da ci gabanka a cikin sabis na Supabase na wannan shafin don koyo a dukkan na'urori. Bi imel ɗin tabbatarwa bayan rajista. Bayanan martaba na gida suna nan daban kuma ba a sake rubuta su kai tsaye.
